summary: Bandwidth-limited node2's traffic through node1 to ~1 Mbit/s in each direction using Linux tc (HTB) on node1's br-lan bridge, while node1's own traffic remains unshaped. Persisted the shaping via an OpenWrt hotplug script so it survives reboot, then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart-and-recovery protocol for all three nodes with proven boot-identity changes.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1 (OpenWrt 25.12.2, br-lan bridge) and node2/node3 (Ubuntu 24.04) share a flat 10.100.171.0/24 network
Installed tc-full, kmod-sched, kmod-ifb, kmod-sched-act-police, iperf3 on node1 via apk
Measured unshaped baseline node1<->node2 throughput (~80 Gbit/s) via iperf3
Configured tc HTB qdisc on br-lan egress with a u32 filter matching dst=node2 into a 1Mbit class (default class unshaped at 899Mbit) to limit node1->node2 traffic
Configured tc ingress qdisc on br-lan redirecting src=node2 traffic to an ifb0 device, shaped to 1Mbit via HTB, to limit node2->node1 traffic
Verified with iperf3: node1->node2 ~839-1050 Kbit/s, node2->node1 ~881-944 Kbit/s, matching the ~1 Mbit/s target in both directions
Verified node1's own traffic (node1->node3) stays unshaped at ~838-847 Mbit/s, confirming the filter is scoped only to node2's IP
Persisted shaping logic in /etc/hotplug.d/iface/30-tc-shape (fires on ifup of the lan interface) so the config survives reboot
Captured boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via native reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed boot_id changed (30e78ddd -> 94a5c6ee), verified tc shaping auto-reapplied and iperf3 test showed ~881 Kbit/s
Restarted node2 via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed (901ef286 -> 9d11fcf3), verified networking recovered and shaping still enforced (~921 Kbit/s)
Restarted node3 via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed (b19a635d -> 01e7f472), verified networking recovered and node1->node3 traffic remained unshaped (~838 Mbit/s)
Final combined verification post full restart cycle: node1<->node2 both directions ~839-910 Kbit/s

evidence.requirement: Baseline unshaped throughput between node1 and node2 before shaping
evidence.summary: iperf3 node2->node1 measured ~80 Gbit/s before any tc rules were applied

evidence.requirement: tc shaping configuration applied on node1 (HTB egress class for dst=node2, ingress redirect+HTB for src=node2)
evidence.summary: tc qdisc/class/filter output showing 1Mbit HTB class bound to node2's IP on both egress (br-lan) and ingress (via ifb0)

evidence.requirement: Demonstrate ~1 Mbit/s limit in node1->node2 (download) direction
evidence.summary: iperf3 -R test measured 917 Kbits/sec receiver-side throughput

evidence.requirement: Demonstrate ~1 Mbit/s limit in node2->node1 (upload) direction
evidence.summary: iperf3 test measured 944 Kbits/sec receiver-side throughput

evidence.requirement: Traffic from node1 itself (to node3) stays unshaped
evidence.summary: iperf3 node1->node3 measured ~840 Mbit/s, unaffected by the node2-specific filter

evidence.requirement: Shaping persists across reboot via hotplug script
evidence.summary: Hotplug script installed at /etc/hotplug.d/iface/30-tc-shape; after node1 reboot, tc qdisc/class state shows shaping was auto-reapplied

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured on all nodes before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id and uptime/service state for node1, node2, node3 prior to any restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered shaping
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed from 30e78ddd to 94a5c6ee; tc shaping and iperf3 (~881 Kbit/s) confirmed post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered networking and shaping
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 901ef286 to 9d11fcf3; network and shaped throughput (~921 Kbit/s) confirmed post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered networking and unshaped node1 traffic
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from b19a635d to 01e7f472; network recovered and node1->node3 traffic still unshaped (~838 Mbit/s) post-restart

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end verification after all three restarts
evidence.summary: Post-full-restart-cycle iperf3 tests show both directions between node1 and node2 still capped near 1 Mbit/s (839-910 Kbit/s)
